# Provenance — `sintel-track.json`

**Generated by** `ops-tools/build-track.mjs` on 2026-09-03.
**model field:** `human-verified-frames` — not AI output, and not labelled as
AI output.

## How every line was written

Each description was written by looking at an actual frame of the real
archive.org Sintel stream at the timestamp recorded in its `frameRef`. The
frames were pulled from a 215-second OBS capture of the app playing the film
(`2026-09-03 17-46-32.mp4`, video time = recording time − 18 s). No description
was written from a plot summary, a synopsis, or memory of the film.

## Coverage — read this before quoting the counters

Only **gap 0** is described: the film's dialogue-free opening, 0.0 – 106.95 s.
The first spoken line in Sintel is at **00:01:47.250**, so the opening 107
seconds carry no dialogue at all — the single most valuable stretch for audio
description, and the one the demo shows.

Gaps 1–12 are **not described**. That is deliberate and must stay visible in
the UI: describing them requires authoring against frames, which is what LIVE
mode (Bedrock Nova Pro, multimodal) exists to do. Inventing them offline is
exactly the failure this file replaces.

`metadata.describedGaps = 1` of `metadata.totalGaps = 13`.

## What was replaced, and why

The previous `sintel-track.json` claimed 28 descriptions across 32 gaps, model
`fixture-handwritten`. It was a plot summary of Sintel with invented
timestamps, fitted to the fabricated `sintel.srt` it shipped alongside. It did
not match the film. Two captured frames make this unarguable:

- At video **01:02** the picture is Sintel standing alone in an open snowfield
  with a spear lying behind her. The app was narrating *"The warm firelight
  inside the mountain hut reflects across the traveler's face."*
- At video **00:04** the picture is a title card over an empty snow slope. The
  app was narrating *"A solitary figure in a dark tattered cloak trudges
  through a heavy blizzard."* — there is no figure on screen.

Evidence frames are kept in `docs/assets/evidence/`.

## The overlap counter

`overlapCount = 0` is now a real claim. It is checked in
`build-track.mjs` against the authoritative dialogue intervals: the build
throws if any two descriptions overlap each other, and throws if the last
description runs past 106.95 s into the first line of dialogue. Previously the
same counter was measured against a dialogue track that did not exist.
